answers: Who keeps it: Training input / Permissioned data markets & licensing

crosswalk.note: Expert data, RL environments and continual-learning infra are the deployment→invention channel; lab recoupment ⇄ capex-to-revenue.

definition: The share of enterprise seats whose contracts let the vendor learn from their sessions, the policy gate on the return arrow (v2 Appendix E).
name: Enterprise sessions allowed to train vendor models
timing_rationale: Leading: a policy that lets sessions train a model comes before any learning from those sessions.
unpublished_reason: Not measurable: the policy is set contract by contract, and no vendor publishes the share of enterprise seats whose sessions may train its models; default opt-outs are recorded as evidence when a vendor changes them.
why_it_matters: Continual learning needs deployment data; enterprise contracts that forbid training on sessions close the arrow for most paid use.
